Each theme is shown in Blend, and each l: Ana nuna kowane jigo a Blend, kuma kowane tsari a Mix; kowane jigo yana aiki a kowane tsari. Idan Follow the artwork a kunne, kamar yadda yake a farko, launin ado yana ɗaukar launin murfin da ake kunnawa. Ana shigar da ƙarin jigogi, kamar Neon Nights da Paper Mint, daga kasuwa.
A theme is a folder with a <code>theme.j: Jigo babban fayil ne mai theme.json: launuka goma sha takwas, haruffa da radius na kusurwa. MixMusic yana zana komai da su, a kowane tsari, don haka jigo yana ci gaba da aiki yayin da manhajar take sauyawa. Bar shi ya bi kwamfutarka, da jigo ɗaya don yanayin haske da ɗaya don yanayin duhu, ko ka sa launukan da pywal ko matugen suke yi daga fuskar bangonka.
Plugins are ES modules that add pages, c: Plugin ES modules ne da suke ƙara shafuka, umarni, ayyukan waƙa da widgets ta hanyar API mai nauʼi, kuma ana shigar da su daga kasuwa da danna sau ɗaya, kamar sleep timer ko spectrum a shafin abin da ake kunnawa. Kowane plugin zai iya amfani da dukan API, kuma MixMusic yana gaya maka haka kafin ka kunna ɗaya.
The same song, for ten minutes, on the s: Waƙa ɗaya, na minti goma, a kan kwamfutar Windows ɗaya. MixMusic tana kunna ta da ɗan ƙaramin kaso na maʼadanar da YouTube Music a cikin burauza ko manhajar Spotify ke amfani da ita.
Memory each app used while it played the: Maʼadanar da kowace manhaja ta yi amfani da ita yayin da take kunna waƙar, a megabyte
Measured on 12 November 2026 on Windows: An auna a ranar 12 ga Nuwamba 2026 a kan Windows 11, inda MixMusic 0.5.10, Chrome 147 da Spotify 1.3.9 kowanne ya kunna “Local Forecast - Elevator” na Kevin MacLeod na minti goma ba tare da sauti ba: maʼadanar da Task Manager ke nunawa, wato private working set na dukkan ayyukan kowace manhaja, matsakaicin minti uku na ƙarshe. Babu asusun da aka shiga a MixMusic da Chrome, kuma Chrome ba ta da wani shafi a buɗe; an shiga Spotify, domin dole ne a shiga kafin ta kunna.
Free for macOS, Windows and Linux. Versi: Kyauta don macOS, Windows da Linux. Sigar 0.5.11; kowane fayil yana shafin fitarwa na GitHub.
macOS 12 and later, Apple silicon and In: macOS 12 zuwa gaba, Apple silicon da Intel.
x64 and Arm64, for Debian, Ubuntu, Fedor: x64 da Arm64, don Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, openSUSE da sauran.
.deb · .rpm · AppImage · Flatpak · .tar.gz tare da rubutun shigarwa
yt-dlp, which MixMusic installs for you: yt-dlp, wanda MixMusic yake shigar maka daga Settings › Playback (Saituna › Kunnawa), da JavaScript runtime a PATH ɗinka: Deno, Node.js, Bun ko QuickJS.
An app of your own from the Spotify deve: Manhaja ta kanka daga dashboard na masu haɓaka Spotify, wadda aka yi da asusun Spotify mai Premium. Jagorar tana jagorantarka.
The macOS app is not notarized yet: open: Apple ba ta tabbatar da manhajar macOS ba tukuna: buɗe ta sau ɗaya daga System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway. Ba a sa wa mai shigarwar Windows sa hannu ba tukuna: idan SmartScreen ya yi gargaɗi, zaɓi More info › Run anyway.
GTK 3, and PulseAudio (which PipeWire se: GTK 3, da PulseAudio (PipeWire ma yana yi masa hidima) ko ALSA; shiga YouTube Music yana buƙatar WebKitGTK 4.1. Flatpak yana buƙatar Flatpak kawai, kuma yana zuwa da sauran. A Debian da Ubuntu:
Check each file against <code>SHA256SUMS: Duba kowane fayil da SHA256SUMS na fitarwar. Tsofaffin sigogi suna a shafin fitarwa ma. Magance matsaloli yana taimakawa idan wani abu ba ya aiki.
What people ask before they install, eac: Abin da mutane suke tambaya kafin su shigar, kowanne da amsa a ƴan layuka, tare da shafin takardu da yake ƙara bayani.
In MixMusic, Settings › About › Report a: A MixMusic, Settings › About › Report a problem yana buɗe sabon issue a GitHub a burauzarka, da sigarka, tsarinka, kayan aikinka, jigonka da plugin ɗinka a cike; babu abin da yake tafiya sai ka aika. Open logs folder, kusa da shi, yana nuna log ɗin da za a haɗa, bayan ka karanta shi. Ko kuma ka buɗe issue da kanka. Magance matsaloli yana ƙunshe da matsalolin da aka fi samu da farko.
MixMusic is open source under the MIT li: MixMusic open source ne a ƙarƙashin lasisin MIT ko GNU GPL, sigar 3: shirin Go guda ɗaya da aka gina a kan MyGo, wanda yake zana tagoginsa da kansa a kan GPU, ba tare da burauza a ciki ba. Gyare-gyare, sabbin siffofi, jigogi, plugin da rahotannin abin da ba ya aiki duka ana maraba da su.
Build it, check it, open a pull request: Gina shi, duba shi, buɗe pull request
Report a bug or ask for a feature: Ba da rahoton kuskure ko roƙon sabuwar siffa
What changed in each release: Abin da ya sauya a kowace fitarwa
